description:
General Information
NEW in the Original Packaging
Stocked & Shipped From – LEXINGTON, KY
What is This Part?
This is the Suzuki OEM Clutch Cable Repair Kit (Nut,Spring,Pin,Washer) to fix missing or worn out pieces on the cable attachment points.
This part attaches the Clutch Cable to the Clutch Release Arm.
EVERYTHING YOU NEED INCLUDED!
Direct Replacement
What Will I Receive?
Qty 1 – Cable Spring
Qty 2 – Cable Washers
Qty 1 – Cable Nut
Qty 1 – Cable Pin
What Vehicle Will This Fit?
Suzuki Samurai 1985 – 1995 All Models
Suzuki SJ413 1985 – 1995 All Models
